A '''Weequay deputy''' was a member of the [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|Ohnaka Gang]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], this Weequay pirate was present on [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]] shortly after their base [[Invasion of Florrum/Legends|was destroyed]] by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[General/Legends|general]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. He received a transmission from [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] who wanted to speak with the gang leader [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] urgently. This Weequay then relayed the message to Hondo who then spoke with Kenobi.

During a skirmish that ensued soon after between traitorous men of Ohnaka and the other pirates, this deputy remained loyal to Ohnaka. After being one of the few members of the Ohnaka Gang to survive the onslaught, this pirate ended up with much wealth and weaponry.
